items.name: react-spa
items.description: React SPA wired to Cognito + backend API.

items.name: aws-datalake-foundation
items.description: Foundational AWS Data Lake on CDK v2: 4 S3 zones (Raw/Clean/Curated Iceberg/Archive), Glue ETL + Step Functions, Lake Formation FGAC, KMS, CloudTrail, and optional VPC + ingestion Lambdas.

items.name: aws-cdk-serverless-backend
items.description: Serverless backend on CDK v2: Cognito (optional Entra ID OIDC), single-table DynamoDB, private S3, Python 3.12 Lambdas + shared layer, and an API Gateway REST API behind a JWT authorizer, plus a library of reusable service constructs.

items.name: frontend-base
items.description: Ready-to-run React SPA (TypeScript, Vite): sidebar shell, sign-in with forced password change, optional role-gated routing, shadcn/Radix components and a two-hue design-token system. Cognito is optional - a mock auth provider lets it run before a user pool exists. Optional user-management CRUD and an optional streaming chat assistant with voice and image attachments.
